arxiv-2110-04412.title: Mobile 3D Printing Robot Simulation with Viscoelastic Fluids
arxiv-2110-04412.creator: Uljad Berdica, Yuewei Fu, Yuchen Liu, Emmanouil Angelidis, Chen Feng, https://ai4ce.github.io/M3DP-Sim
arxiv-2110-04412.description: Abstract The system design and algorithm development of mobile 3D printing robots need a realistic simulation. They require a mobile robot simulation platform to interoperate with a physics-based material simulation for handling interactions between the time-variant deformable 3D printing materials and other simulated rigid bodies in the environment, which is not available for roboticists yet.

arxiv-2206-05596.title: Neural Network-based Flight Control Systems: Present and Future Journal: Annual Reviews in Control
arxiv-2206-05596.creator: Seyyed Ali Emami, Paolo Castaldi, Afshin Banazadeh
arxiv-2206-05596.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Seyyed Ali Emami, Paolo Castaldi, Afshin Banazadeh. As the first review in this field, this paper presents an in-depth mathematical view of Intelligent Flight Control Systems (IFCSs), particularly those based on artificial neural networks. The rapid evolution of IFCSs in the last two decades in both the methodological and technical aspects necessitates a comprehensive view of them to better demonstrate the current stage and the crucial remaining steps towards developing a truly intelligent flight management unit.

arxiv-2406-07192.description: Abstract We consider convergence properties of the long-term behaviors with respect to the coefficient of the stochastic term for a nonautonomous stochastic p p -Laplacian lattice equation with multiplicative noise. First, the upper semi-continuity of pullback random ( ℓ 2 , ℓ q ) (\ell^{2},\ell^{q}) -attractor is proved for each q ∈ [ 1 , + ∞ ) q\in[1,+\infty) .

arxiv-2602-06588.title: Band-Ensemble Spectral Proper Orthogonal Decomposition with Frequency Attribution
arxiv-2602-06588.creator: Jakob G. R. von Saldern, Oliver T. Schmidt, Philipp Godbersen, J. Moritz Reumschüssel, Tim Colonius
arxiv-2602-06588.description: Abstract This study presents band-ensemble Spectral Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (bSPOD). The approach is inspired by frequency smoothing, a method used to reduce estimator variance in power spectral density estimates, and is here extended to SPOD. The algorithm estimates SPOD modes from consecutive Fourier coefficients obtained from a single Fourier transform of the full time record and thus avoids time segmentation.

pmc-11396062.title: The n-Butanol Extract Obtained from the Inner Bark of Tabebuia rosea (Bertol.) DC, Specioside, and Catalposide Induce Leukemia Cell Apoptosis in the Presence of Apicidin
pmc-11396062.creator: Nancy Yadira Guerrero-Pepinosa, Luz Angela Veloza, Juan Carlos Sepúlveda-Arias
pmc-11396062.description: The cell signaling pathways involved in the antiproliferative activities of T. rosea inner bark remain unexplored. This study evaluated the apoptotic effects of two iridoids from the inner bark of T. rosea and apicidin on THP-1 cells. The cytotoxic effects of the extract and the pure compounds on THP-1 and Jurkat cells were also evaluated using the MTT assay.

pmc-11615222.title: A 2-year pure biochar addition enhances soil carbon sequestration and reduces aggregate stability in understory conditions
pmc-11615222.creator: Jiabin Wei, Youqing Li, Juan Li, Wei Yan, Qi Yin, Hongwei Jiang, Zongling Li, Jinyu Jiang, Yu Li, Yu Yao, Lang Zhang
pmc-11615222.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The enhancement of soil aggregate size and stability is crucial for mitigating climate change and improving carbon sequestration in forest ecosystems. Biochar, derived from rice husks, has been suggested as an effective mean to increase soil carbon storage. However, isolating biochar’s specific effects on soil aggregate formation and carbon sink capacity can be complex due to the overlapping influences of fertilization and understory vegetation cultivation.

pmc-12495043.title: Probiotic Levilactobacillus brevis GH1 from baijiu Daqu enhanced γ-aminobutyric acid and antioxidant ability in Cordyceps militaris fruiting body extract and brown rice beverage
pmc-12495043.creator: Kaihui Shen, Zhengyan Lei, Shuqi Zhou, Jun Wang, Anjun Li, Jiangjing Gao, Ganggang Cao, Luchan Gong
pmc-12495043.description: γ-Aminobutyric acid (GABA) is a functional amino acid with various physiological activities. Increasing the concentration of GABA in foods and enhancing dietary supplementation are important for health benefits. Baijiu, a traditional Chinese liquor, is one of the oldest and most consumed fermented beverages. Daqu, the fermentation starter of Baijiu, contains functional lactic acid bacteria.

pmc-12526521.title: Practical Application of Passive Air-Coupled Ultrasonic Acoustic Sensors for Wheel Crack Detection
pmc-12526521.creator: Aashish Shaju, Nikhil Kumar, Giovanni Mantovani, Steve Southward, Mehdi Ahmadian
pmc-12526521.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Passive air-coupled ultrasonic acoustic (UA) sensors were tested in both laboratory and track settings, where a reliable acoustic fingerprint for wheel damage was identified. The decay rate emerged as the primary diagnostic feature, achieving near-perfect ROC performance for severely damaged wheels.

pmc-12781634.title: Evaluation of urinary extracellular vesicles and microRNAs to diagnose urogenital tuberculosis
pmc-12781634.creator: Parijat Das, Dharmendra K Chaudhary, Richa Mishra, Swasti Tiwari
pmc-12781634.description: BACKGROUNDIndia has the highest tuberculosis (TB) burden in the world. Of the estimated annual 10 million TB cases, features of extra pulmonary TB are evident in up to 45%. Urogenital TB (UGTB) accounts for approximately 20% of those cases. The lack of non-sputum based diagnostic tools continue to hinder efforts to reduce the burden of UGTB.

pmc-12828047.title: Research on cloud-edge-end distributed collaborative computing based on deep reinforcement learning
pmc-12828047.creator: Chunpeng Wu, Qinghe Ye, Yue Wang, Dengkai Zhang, Wenli Zhang, Xingguo Jiang
pmc-12828047.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). With the large-scale integration of renewable energy sources, the number of data acquisition terminals and the sampling frequency in distribution networks have increased rapidly, placing higher demands on the system’s computing and communication resource scheduling capabilities. This paper focuses on collaborative resource management and intelligent scheduling under a cloud–edge–device distributed architecture, and conducts a study on collaborative computing based on deep reinforcement learning.

pmc-13040556.creator: Anna Fiesinger, Abdoallah Sharaf, Rachel Alderdice, Gabriela Perna, Hannah Manns, John A. Burt, Christian R. Voolstra, Anna Fiesinger, Anna Fiesinger
pmc-13040556.description: We present a genome assembly from the coral species Porites harrisoni from the southern Persian/Arabian Gulf, the hottest ocean basin where corals live. The assembly is 626.7 Mb in size, spanning 1,883 contigs with a contig N50 of 807.4 kb, including a single-contig mitochondrial genome. The assembly has a BUSCO completeness of 86.3% (single = 72.5%, duplicated = 13.

pmc-13287883.title: 52Treatment patterns among patients with extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with autoimmune conditions: a retrospective study
pmc-13287883.creator: Sumera I Ilyas, Milind M Javle, Nilofer S Azad, Shishir K Maithel, Juan W Valle, Mitesh J Borad, Nehemiah Kebede, Young Jung, Sheena L Dupuy, Stephen J Valerio, Rachna T Shroff
pmc-13287883.description: Background & ObjectivesBased on the TOPAZ-I study, durvalumab combined with gemcitabine and cisplatin (GemCis) is now supported as a standard of care treatment for cholangiocarcinoma. Patients with extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (eCCA) often have underlying autoimmune conditions (AICs) which could restrict immunotherapy use. Treatment patterns in patients with eCCA with AICs and non-autoimmune conditions (NAICs) are reported.

pmc-13467942.creator: Jiaxing Wang, Zhiwei Ma, Xingyu Duan, Yingqin Jia, Yuxin Gao, Qian Zhao, Jiong Wang, Ningkui Niu
